retrievalProfile.description: A rustic, Americana-inspired layout featuring dual portraits blended with a rural landscape and centered, distressed block typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition featuring two male figures in western attire, layered over a vanishing-point perspective of a dirt road, with a central graphic icon and distressed sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Dual portraits flanking a central vanishing point
Textured overlay of landscape onto clothing
Centralized alignment of icon and text
Warm, earthy foreground transitioning to a cool, cloudy sky
coreInvariants: Distressed, weathered texture applied to all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary subjects in medium-close-up, one on the left foreground and one on the right mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A central longhorn skull icon positioned directly above the main text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the left subject's face, down the dirt road perspective, to the central text, then to the right subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with portraits, landscape, and an acoustic guitar in the lower right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy ochre and terracotta (dirt road and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Denim blue and muted sky blue
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with a gritty, high-contrast value range.

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges to simulate weathering
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is slightly smaller and centered between names
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with color and scale variation for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence.
Provides the correct condensed sans-serif skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a composite image of two men in cowboy hats and denim/western shirts. Blend their figures with a central dirt road receding into a cloudy blue sky. Include an acoustic guitar in the bottom right corner. Apply a warm, gritty, sepia-toned texture to the lower half.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a white longhorn skull icon in the center. Below it, add two lines of bold, condensed, distressed sans-serif text. The top line should be white and the bottom line should be orange-red.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and distressed?
Are the two subjects clearly visible but blended with the landscape?
Is the color palette dominated by earth tones and denim blue?
Is the longhorn icon present above the text?

adjustableVariables: Balance between blue sky and orange earth
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for distressed texture on text
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine dual western portraits + vanishing point landscape + distressed condensed sans-serif + central rustic icon.
